notes.title: The game will be released on June 27th at 2pm Beijing time. Thanks for purchase！
notes.notes: [p]To all respected players, in order to provide a better gaming experience, we have decided to release the game earlier in order to collect user feedback. The AI logic of "Chinese Chess Way" uses cloud computing and [b][u]requires network connectivity during gameplay[/u][/b]. Please pay special attention. In addition, although we have conducted multiple rounds of testing, due to the game's first release, there may be some oversights. We sincerely ask for your understanding and forgiveness! After sales, we will continue to pay attention to everyone's feedback and update it in a timely manner. Thank you for your support![/p][p][/p][p]Respected by the "Chinese Chess Way" project team of Shanghai Seeing Technology Ltd.[/p]
